rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst and notes possible hatching/thinned zona, but overstates visibility of a well-defined blastocoel and cohesive TE from this soft-focus static image; image-based staging is less certain than implied and relies heavily on the provided 4AA grade.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, male factor, partner age, prior miscarriage, endometrial thickness, and day-5 high-grade morphology into prognosis and counseling.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate emphasis on morphology versus ploidy limits; only minor issue is a somewhat confident probability estimate despite image uncertainty and broad assumptions.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, no bed rest, and selective PGT-A discussion; minor overreach in suggesting some investigations before clear indications.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, progesterone optimization, male-factor workup, and future-cycle strategy, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
